description: Digital Gold Rush: Cloudburst Data Center's Water Demand Impact On The Edwards Aquifer is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Annie Vo. Spatial analysis of CloudBurst data center's water demand relative to Edwards Aquifer recharge zones in Hays County. Data sources include EAA regulatory zone shapefiles, TWDB groundwater well locations, and TNRIS county boundaries. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
